scripts.demo:orb: pnpm run demo:build && node dist-examples/examples/component-lab.js orb

scripts.demo:agent-status: pnpm run demo:build && node dist-examples/examples/component-lab.js agent-status
scripts.demo:request-status: pnpm run demo:build && node dist-examples/examples/component-lab.js request-status
scripts.demo:execution: pnpm run demo:build && node dist-examples/examples/component-lab.js execution
scripts.demo:streaming: pnpm run demo:build && node dist-examples/examples/component-lab.js streaming
